content.text:
Cross-file trace complete. Traces run: resolve-endpoint consumers, quote-token endpoint consumers (email/SMS/PDF URLs still point at the kept `/trades/quote/:token` route — OK), wouter Route render-prop form (verified `ParamsCtx.Provider` still supplies `useParams` — OK), split-payment imports (all resolve; `subtitleStyle` merely unused), storage stub fallbacks (unreachable in practice), sw.js copies (identical, no divergence). Three candidates with nameable failure scenarios survive:

```json
[
  {
    "file": "client/src/pages/checkout.tsx",
    "line": 207,
    "summary": "First-time quote visitors always skip step 1 in real mode: GET /api/trades/quotes/token/:token marks the quote viewed and returns the updated row, so quote.viewedAt is non-null on the very first fetch and the effect immediately forces quoteStep to 'confirm'.",
    "failure_scenario": "Customer opens an emailed quote link for the first time against the real server (routes.ts:6745 sets status→viewed + viewedAt on that same GET) → useEffect sees quote.viewedAt set → setQuoteStep('confirm') → the 'view quote' step is never shown; the mock returns viewedAt:null, which is why screenshots showed step 1 — real mode behaves differently from the verified demo."
  },
  {
    "file": "server/routes.ts",
    "line": 6797,
    "summary": "Quote GET response's merchant object omits customLogoUrl, so white-label merchants' logo never replaces the taptpay wordmark during the quote steps (checkout.tsx:1108 falls back to null in quote phase where both merchant and invoiceData queries are disabled/empty).",
    "failure_scenario": "Merchant with customLogoUrl sends a quote → customer opens /trades/quote/:token → quote phase renders <TaptWordmark customLogoUrl={null}> showing the taptpay brand instead of the merchant's logo, then the logo abruptly appears after acceptance when the invoice resolve supplies it — violates the confirmed requirement 'merchant customLogoUrl still replaces the wordmark'."
  },
  {
    "file": "public/sw.js",
    "line": 104,
    "summary": "New cache-first /assets/ service-worker branch assumes everything under /assets/ is content-hashed, but non-hashed static files (e.g. /assets/fonts/LarkenDEMO-Black.otf, shell-*.webp from client/public/assets/) are served from the same prefix and get cached forever without any cache-version bump.",
    "failure_scenario": "Deploy replaces or updates a font/image in client/public/assets/ keeping the same filename → returning users' service worker serves the stale cached copy indefinitely (STATIC_CACHE name 'taptpay-static-v3' unchanged) → old font/asset persists until the SW cache version is manually bumped."
  }
]
```

Out-of-scope note: `client/public/app/assets/checkout-*.js` is a stale pre-built demo bundle still carrying the old blue design and old resolve consumer — already flagged in the plan as an optional follow-up.
